# attested form

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attestedForm`](gmeow-attestedForm.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attestedForm>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The lexical form that a usage attestation observes. Functional per relator: one attested form per [`UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) -> [`gmeow:LexicalForm`](../classes/gmeow-LexicalForm.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:attestedForm`](gmeow-attestedForm.md) from [`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) to [`gmeow:LexicalForm`](../classes/gmeow-LexicalForm.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md), [`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md), [`gmeow:LexicalForm`](../classes/gmeow-LexicalForm.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a [`UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) to name the single lexical form it records as observed — the observation's feature of interest.

### Avoid when

- Avoid more than one attested form per attestation (it is functional; mint a separate attestation per form) and avoid naming the source here (that is [`gmeow:attestedInSource`](gmeow-attestedInSource.md)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:attestedForm`](gmeow-attestedForm.md) once from the relator to its [`gmeow:LexicalForm`](../classes/gmeow-LexicalForm.md); it specializes [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md), so generic observation queries find it by inheritance.

### Examples

- ex:att1 [`gmeow:attestedForm`](gmeow-attestedForm.md) ex:waterWritten.
